tasks.label: Run backend (FastAPI)
args: $envFile = Join-Path '${workspaceFolder}' '.env'; Get-Content $envFile | Where-Object { $_ -match '^\s*[^#][^=]*=' } | ForEach-Object { $pair = $_ -split '=', 2; $name = $pair[0].Trim(); $value = $pair[1].Trim().Trim([char]34).Trim([char]39); [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($name, $value, 'Process') }; Set-Location (Join-Path '${workspaceFolder}' 'backend'); python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
